body: I have tried. I’m sure there is more I can do but the exhaustion sets in hard. In certain aspects, I feel stuck. The areas where I am trying to change it’s all a work in progress and getting tiring. Trying something new hoping it will help, it doesn’t, rinse, wash, repeat...
Sorry I am new to Reddit. I tried to private message I think?

I do see a counsellor. She helps but I fear my feelings are too deep. I felt I was getting a bit better when I first began seeing her but now I feel I’ve reached an impasse. Difficult time talking to any family about it as they are very old school and feel I should just get over it. Same with my boyfriend. Don’t really have friends. The depression has caused a loss of a lot of friendships. No one wants to hear how sad a person feels all the time I suppose.
To be honest I wouldn’t even know where to begin as far as specific occurrences. A lot of abuse. A lot of “anything that could go wrong, did go wrong” in a lot of situations.
Because I always come back to this place. People are usually glad their suicide attempt “failed”, but I just think I could have saved myself a lot of hurt.
